text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing parking prohibition on both sides of Clintwood Gate, between Broadlands Boulevard and Victoria Park Avenue, be rescinded. The 12-metre road width is sufficient to allow parking on both sides of the street and two-way travel. The unsigned three-hour parking will be in effect at all times.
North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition, in effect at all times, on both sides of Clintwood Gate, between Victoria Park Avenue and Broadlands Boulevard.
